_comment: POPULATED REFERENCE manifest showing every azure-ai-projects 2.3.0 toolbox tool type AI4IA can place in a toolbox (all 12: web_search, azure_ai_search, code_interpreter, browser_automation_preview, file_search, openapi, mcp, toolbox_search_preview, a2a_preview, fabric_iq_preview, work_iq_preview, reminder_preview), each with at least one populated example. This is an EXAMPLE only (the canonical live toolbox is foundry/toolbox.manifest.json). To use it, copy this over toolbox.manifest.json (or pass --manifest foundry/toolbox.manifest.example.json), prune the tools you do not want, create the referenced connections, then run scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py. Every tool listed here is consumed through the official-MCP APIM front door once the toolbox is registered in infra/mcp-servers.json. Note: computer_use and bing_custom_search are agent-level tools with no toolbox equivalent in the SDK, so they are not toolbox tools. The service allows at most one unnamed tool total, so every tool here has a `name` (or `serverLabel` for `mcp` tools). Tool types whose name ends in `_preview` (browser_automation_preview, toolbox_search_preview, a2a_preview, fabric_iq_preview, work_iq_preview, reminder_preview) are Azure public preview; the rest are generally available.
name: ai4ia-toolbox
description: AI4IA shared Foundry toolbox (populated reference). Groups grounding, code execution, browsing, and tool search behind one APIM-fronted MCP endpoint.

tools.name: web-search
tools.description: Grounded public web search. Connectionless. Demonstrates the optional filters/userLocation/searchContextSize fields (SDK 2.3.0's WebSearchToolboxTool); all three are independent of customSearchConfiguration (see web-search-custom below).

tools.name: web-search-custom
tools.description: Grounded web search scoped to a Bing Custom Search instance instead of the general web. customSearchConfiguration is optional (SDK 2.3.0's WebSearchConfiguration); both nested fields are required together when present. Requires the 'ai4ia-bing-custom-search' project connection.

tools.name: ai4ia-rag
tools.description: RAG over the AI4IA AI Search index. Requires the 'ai4ia-search' project connection. Shape is azureAiSearch.indexes[] (SDK 2.3.0's AzureAISearchToolResource), not root-level indexName/projectConnectionId. indexName and projectConnectionId are required together (see ai4ia-rag-by-asset below for the indexAssetId alternative); the two shapes are mutually exclusive per index entry.

tools.name: ai4ia-rag-by-asset
tools.description: Alternative azure_ai_search shape: reference an already-registered AI Search index ASSET by ID instead of indexName+projectConnectionId (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's AISearchIndexResource.index_asset_id). Mutually exclusive with indexName/projectConnectionId on the same index entry; exactly one index per tool either way. Modeled per explicit product direction -- Microsoft's published 'Configure tool parameters' guide only documents the indexName+projectConnectionId form, so confirm the expected asset-id format against your Foundry project before relying on this in production (see docs/foundry-toolbox.md).

tools.name: code-interpreter
tools.description: Foundry-managed sandboxed Python (distinct from AI4IA's existing direct Responses-API code interpreter).

tools.name: code-interpreter-custom-limits
tools.description: Foundry-managed sandbox with custom resource limits and a restricted outbound network policy (nested auto object). NOT a custom/BYO container image: `container` as a string means an EXISTING container ID, and the object form only supports the auto/managed sandbox (fileIds/memoryLimit/networkPolicy), never an arbitrary image reference. For genuinely custom execution logic, run your own server and add it as an `mcp` tool instead (see the `mcp` example below). networkPolicy.allowlist here restricts sandbox egress to PyPI (SDK 2.3.0's ContainerNetworkPolicyParam); the SDK also supports a `domainSecrets` list on the allowlist variant, but that is a literal secret value per domain, so it is intentionally not modeled in this manifest schema (this file is committed to source control).

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Drive a hosted browser via a connected Playwright Workspace (preview; heavier isolation review recommended). Requires the 'ai4ia-browser-automation' project connection (a Playwright Workspace connection, not a plain API connection). Shape is browserAutomationPreview.connection.projectConnectionId (SDK 2.3.0's BrowserAutomationToolParameters), which is nested one level deeper than the toolbox-search example above.

tools.name: file-search
tools.description: Search files attached to the toolbox via a vector store. Connectionless once files are attached. Demonstrates maxNumResults/rankingOptions/filters (SDK 2.3.0's FileSearchToolboxTool); filters here is a compound (and) tree of comparison filters over vector-store file metadata, distinct from web_search's allowed-domains filters shape.

tools.name: openapi-example
tools.description: Call an OpenAPI-described REST API as a tool. Replace the placeholder spec with a real one.

openapi.name: get_weather
openapi.description: Look up the current weather for a city.

tools.description: Nest an upstream MCP server as a tool (identified by serverLabel, not name). Requires the 'ai4ia-mcp-upstream' project connection for auth.

Second mcp example demonstrating serverDescription/allowedTools/deferLoading/toolConfigs and the object form of requireApproval (SDK 2.3.0's MCPToolRequireApproval), as an alternative to the literal 'always'/'never' shown above. requireApproval here allows the read-only 'search_docs' tool without approval while still gating everything else via the toolbox default.
tools.serverDescription: Internal knowledge-base MCP server exposing search and lookup tools.

tools.name: tool-search
tools.description: Tool search: lets the model pick from a large tool set. Add so the toolbox self-describes its tools.

tools.name: a2a-agent
tools.description: Delegate to a remote Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol agent (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's A2APreviewToolboxTool). Requires the 'ai4ia-a2a-agent' project connection, which stores the remote agent's endpoint and auth -- this is Microsoft's documented approach. One of projectConnectionId or baseUrl is required; use baseUrl+agentCardPath instead (with sendCredentialsForAgentCard) for a self-contained, connectionless call to an anonymous agent.

tools.name: fabric-iq
tools.description: Ground responses in a Microsoft Fabric IQ knowledge source (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's FabricIQPreviewToolboxTool). Requires the 'ai4ia-fabric-iq' project connection. serverLabel/serverUrl/requireApproval are optional here (shared field names with mcp); serverUrl defaults to the connection's own URL when omitted.

tools.name: work-iq
tools.description: Ground responses in Microsoft 365 Work IQ (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's WorkIQPreviewToolboxTool). Requires the 'ai4ia-work-iq' project connection; this is the tool's only field.

tools.name: reminder
tools.description: Lets the model schedule reminders for the caller (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's ReminderPreviewToolboxTool). No type-specific fields or connection required.
